title: Stacked Queries + OPENROWSET BULK File Exfiltration on MSSQL
learning_objectives: Recognise SQL injection in a MSSQL-backed search endpoint where the response is normalised to a count (no result echo, no error text)
Exploit MSSQL stacked queries: unlike Oracle/MySQL, MSSQL executes every semicolon-separated statement in a batch
Use sp_configure + RECONFIGURE to enable Ad Hoc Distributed Queries at runtime as sysadmin
Read arbitrary server-side files via OPENROWSET(BULK ... SINGLE_CLOB)
Exfiltrate data through a cross-table INSERT into a table the application exposes on a different endpoint
flag_hint: Inject stacked queries: category=Laptops'; INSERT INTO notices(title,body) SELECT 'exfil',mssql_secret FROM secrets WHERE id=1; -- then GET /notices for the secret, POST /solve {"secret":"<32 hex>"}. Bonus: enable OPENROWSET via sp_configure for arbitrary file reads.
inspired_by: SpecterOps and MDSec MSSQL post-exploitation research — abstracted to stacked queries + OPENROWSET BULK on Linux MSSQL (xp_cmdshell unavailable on Linux)
